newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade light, mixed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade light, mixed - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales - compared to Thursday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were not well established with few sales steady. Trade was slow and demand moderate. Seller interest was light, with offerings moderate and current. Confirmed Sales: 400 Week Ago: 400 Year Ago: 2,600 Week to Date: 400 Week Ago: 400 Year Ago: 2,600 Steers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1250 lbs 2 ld 66.00 Heifers: Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales

Carcass Basis (weight only) - compared to Thursday's close, slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a very light test.
